document.about: US Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management, awarded major procurements (Acrobat PDFMaker for Excel), on a large page. A ruled grid of one row a contract; a few rows are tall, a long description wrapped down the first column, or the contractors of a multiple award listed down theirs.
